results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: Validate the connected account using GITHUB_GET_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER (confirm auth works; retain only minimal non-identifying signals such as success/booleans/counts).

[Optional (if REST identity signals are unreliable/inconclusive)] [Step]: Cross-check the same identity signal using GITHUB_GET_VIEWER_GRAPHQL (sanity-check consistency without collecting profile details).

[Optional (if you need to confirm repository visibility/scope)] [Next Step]: Spot-check accessible repositories using GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORIES_FOR_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER (start with a small page; paginate only if results appear truncated/inconclusive).
[Optional (if organization-based access is expected)] [Next Step]: Spot-check organization visibility using GITHUB_LIST_ORGANIZATIONS_FOR_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER (paginate only if needed).
[Optional (if diagnosing GraphQL failures/throttling)] [Step]: Check remaining GraphQL headroom using GITHUB_GET_GRAPHQL_RATE_LIMIT (use only as directional quota context).

[Fallback (if identity checks fail with 401/403 or indicate missing/inactive auth)] [Fallback]: Complete authorization out-of-band, then retry GITHUB_GET_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER (repeat spot-checks only if still needed).
known_pitfalls: [GITHUB_GET_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER] 401/403 or inactive-authorization style failures typically require completing authorization before retrying.
[GITHUB_GET_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER] Some runners require an explicit empty arguments object {} to avoid tool-argument validation errors.
[GITHUB_GET_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER] Responses may include sensitive profile fields; avoid logging or sharing full payloads.
[GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORIES_FOR_THE_AUTHENTICATED_USER] Large repository sets can be bulky/truncated; keep pages small and avoid exposing private repository metadata.
[GITHUB_GET_GRAPHQL_RATE_LIMIT] Reflects GraphQL quota only; REST calls may be governed by separate limits, so treat it as directional.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Read a multi-call JSON response and print only non-identifying keys/counts.
Extract a compact repository summary (counts only).
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
repos=d["results"][0]["response"]["data"].get("repositories",[])
priv=sum(1 for r in repos if r.get("private"))
print(len(repos),priv,len(repos)-priv)
```
